abilities.name: Fury
abilities.text: Use Fury instead of Mana, which is gained by taking damage or dealing Basic Attack damage. Using a Basic or Heroic Ability grants 10% Movement Speed for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Ancient Spear
abilities.text: Throw out a spear that pulls Sonya to the first enemy hit, dealing 173 damage and briefly stunning them. If this hits an enemy, generate 40 Fury.

abilities.name: Seismic Slam
abilities.text: Deals 176 damage to the target enemy, and 44 to enemies behind the target.

abilities.name: Whirlwind
abilities.text: Deals 138 damage a second to nearby enemies for 3 seconds, healing for 25% of damage dealt. Healing tripled versus Heroes.

abilities.name: Leap
abilities.text: Leap into the air, dealing 135 damage to nearby enemies, and stunning them for 1.25 seconds.

abilities.name: Wrath of the Berserker
abilities.text: Increase damage dealt by 40%. Reduce the duration of Stuns, Roots, and Slows against Sonya by 50%. Lasts 15 seconds, and extends by 1 second for every 10 Fury gained.

1.name: Furious Blow
1.text: Every 4th cast of Seismic Slam deals 40% more damage to the primary target and costs no Fury.

1.name: War Paint
1.text: Sonya's Basic Attacks heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

1.name: Tough As Nails
1.text:
Every 16 seconds, gain 60 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 60%.

Stores up to 3 charges. Charges refresh 200% faster while Fury's Movement Speed bonus is active.

4.name: Shattered Ground
4.text: Increase Seismic Slam's splash damage by 250%. Targeting a Hero with Seismic Slam further increases its splash damage by 250%, while targeting other enemies increases the length of its splash by 66%.

4.name: Hurricane
4.text: Reduce the cooldown of Whirlwind by 2 seconds. Casting Whirlwind removes all Slows and Roots from Sonya.

4.name: Shot Of Fury
4.text:
Activate to gain 50 Fury. Usable while Whirlwinding.

Passive: After casting Seismic Slam, your next Basic Attack deals 40% more damage.

7.name: Poisoned Spear
7.text: Ancient Spear deals an additional 100% damage over 6 seconds.

7.name: Life Funnel
7.text: Increases the healing of Whirlwind to 35% of damage dealt.

7.name: Battle Rage
7.text:
Activate to instantly restore 10% of Sonya's maximum Health. Stores up to 2 charges. Usable while Whirlwinding.

Passive: Sonya deals 25% more damage to Mercenaries.

10.name: Leap
10.text: Leap into the air, dealing 135 damage to nearby enemies, and stunning them for 1.25 seconds.

10.name: Wrath of the Berserker
10.text: Increase damage dealt by 40%. Reduce the duration of Stuns, Roots, and Slows against Sonya by 50%. Lasts 15 seconds, and extends by 1 second for every 10 Fury gained.

13.name: Mystical Spear
13.text: Ancient Spear always pulls Sonya to the target location even if it doesn't hit an enemy. When used this way, Ancient Spear's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds.

13.name: Ruthless
13.text: Whirlwind deals an additional 50 damage per second to Heroes below 50% Health. Does not generate additional healing.

13.name: No Escape
13.text: Increases the Movement Speed bonus from using Basic and Heroic Abilities to 20%.

16.name: Giant Slammer
16.text: Basic Attacks and Seismic Slam deal an additional 1.5% of Heroes' maximum Health as damage and heal Sonya for 60% of the damage dealt.

16.name: Rampage
16.text: Increase Basic Attack damage by 25%. Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Ancient Spear by 1.5 seconds.

16.name: Nerves of Steel
16.text: Activate to gain 25% of your maximum Health as a Shield for 3 seconds. Usable while Whirlwinding.

20.name: Arreat Crater
20.text: Leap leaves behind an impassable crater for 5 seconds. Reduces Leap's cooldown by 20 seconds.

20.name: Striding Giant
20.text: Wrath of the Berserker increases maximum Health by 10% and grants Striding Giant, which can be activated to become Unstoppable for 2 seconds. 30 second cooldown.

20.name: Composite Spear
20.text: Increases Ancient Spear's range by 50%. Hitting an enemy Hero with Ancient Spear grants 25 Armor for 4 seconds.

20.name: Ignore Pain
20.text: Activate to gain 60 Armor for 4 seconds, taking 60% less damage. Usable while Whirlwinding.
